name: Command menu
summary: A search-first menu for every action and page, grouped, with keyboard shortcuts, live filtering and an empty result that says what to try.
use: as the keyboard-first way to reach any page or action in a work app
a11y: A combobox with a listbox: arrow keys move the active option through aria-activedescendant, and groups hide when nothing in them matches.

use_when: a jump-to search over pages and records in a tool with many screens, opened from a shortcut
avoid_when: a few actions on one item: use action-menu
the main navigation people see all the time: use sidebar-nav
asking an assistant a free question: use ai-composer

parts.name: search
parts.what: the filter box with its placeholder

parts.name: groups
parts.what: a group heading such as Actions or Go to

parts.name: options
parts.what: one command: icon, label, optional count and shortcut

parts.name: empty
parts.what: the line shown when nothing matches

parts.name: footer
parts.what: key hints for move, open and close

empty.how: when nothing matches, groups hide and a line says what to try
empty.evidence: No commands match. Try a shorter word.

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if search fails, show the empty line with the error text and a retry hint in place of the options

disabled.how: for a command that cannot run now, set aria-disabled on its option, grey it and skip it with the arrow keys

overflow.how: the list has a fixed height of about nine rows and scrolls on its own; arrow keys keep the active option in view

long_text.how: long command labels are cut with an ellipsis on one line

keyboard: Typing in the search box filters the commands and hides empty groups
Down and Up arrows move the active option and wrap at the ends; the search box keeps focus
Enter and Esc are shown in the footer but the file does not handle them
